content.short: Unleash the Otherworldly Wonders - Own Your Piece of the Universe with Intergalactic Beastiary NFTs
content.description: The Intergalactic Passes are a set of three galactic passes that are part of the Intergalactic Beastiary project with a total supply of 300. Passes are categorized into three rarities, similar to previous Time Shifter Passes. To make trading of the passes more engaging, we have introduced a new feature. The pass type that experiences the highest trading volume during the two weeks after its launch will receive a 100% royalty from aftermarket sales, which will be distributed among pass holders.
content.meta: Find out about Intergalactic Beastiary (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
